role: The coach lines VoiceConversationController speaks in .triggerSpeaking (alerts, mile markers, route lines, AI-worded interjections): each line claims the workout-cue audio session through BackgroundAudioManager.beginCue() off the main actor before it is handed to the synthesizer, in order, and its finish or cancel (or stopAll) ends its hold, so with voice chat idle the session is active only while a coach line plays and is deactivated after it. Also holds the scripted fallback of the AI interjection in flight and its stall deadline.
types: CoachCueSpeech: class (@MainActor final) — per-line cue-session claims and the interjection fallback
CoachCueSpeech.Waiting: struct (private) — a line waiting for the session and its refusal callback
CoachCueSpeech.Held: struct (private) — a line handed to the synthesizer, its CueToken and manager
state: mem:CoachCueSpeech.waiting (lines waiting for the session, oldest first)
mem:CoachCueSpeech.held ([ObjectIdentifier: Held]; keeps each spoken utterance alive until its hold ends)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: waiting and held empty, isClaiming false, fallbackGeneration 0; static fallbackDeadlineNanoseconds = 6_000_000_000. Owned by VoiceConversationController as a lazy property over its synthesizer.

units.does: The scripted line the AI interjection in flight falls back to; every set bumps fallbackGeneration, which disarms any deadline armed for an earlier value.
units.entry: Set by VoiceConversationController.startAIInterjectionStream(prompt:fallback:); cleared by speak, stopAll and takeFallback.

units.does: Stores the conversation's synthesizer and the provider of the BackgroundAudioManager to claim (default: AppDependencies.current.collection.backgroundAudioManager, read when a claim starts; tests pass a manager over a recording session).
True while the synthesizer speaks or a coach line still waits for the cue session, so the conversation doesn't treat the coach as finished before its line has started.
Takes one coach line: retires the fallback (something is being said), appends the line and its refusal callback to the waiting list, and starts the claim loop unless one is already running.
units.entry: Called by VoiceConversationController.speak(_:voice:scripted:) for every line spoken in .triggerSpeaking.

branches.effect: return: the running loop speaks it in turn; else start the loop in a main-actor Task

units.does: The claim loop, one line at a time in order: claims a cue hold with beginCue() in a detached task (activation can block), and back on the main actor checks the line is still first. A line dropped meanwhile (stopAll) gives its hold straight back (endCue). Otherwise the line leaves the waiting list, its hold is recorded under its identity, and it is handed to the synthesizer via FRSafeSpeak; a refused line logs, ends its hold and runs its onUnqueued callback. Ends when nothing is waiting.

branches.effect: claim and speak it; none → isClaiming = false, done

branches.cond: the claimed line is no longer first (dropped)

units.does: A line finished or was cancelled: removes its hold by utterance identity and ends it (endCue). Identities this object never handed to the synthesizer, or already released, are ignored.
units.entry: VoiceConversationController didFinish / didCancel delegate hops; the claim loop on a refused line.

units.does: The conversation stopped its speech: drops the waiting lines and the fallback, and ends every held line's hold whether or not the synthesizer reports each cancel (a later cancel finds nothing to end).
Returns the fallback and clears it, so it is said at most once.

With a fallback set, waits fallbackDeadlineNanoseconds (6 s) in a main-actor task and then runs onStall only if that same fallback is still unused (the generation is unchanged and the fallback is still set: nothing has been said, and the interjection has not failed, ended or been replaced). No fallback → nothing armed.
calls: closure:onStall — cancels the stalled stream and runs finishInterjectionAfterError

branches.cond: self gone, generation changed, or fallback cleared
